source: Three id vectors of behaviour 1.1 (EC-ID-01..03, T-15a-012), hand-written, plus one more. The Google Drive vector was produced on 2026-10-09 by running the Kotlin generateId formula (HttpSource.kt) on a JVM MessageDigest MD5 for name 'Google Drive', lang 'all', version 1. It is the formula's output for that input, not a confirmed id of the real Google Drive source. OPEN BLOCKER (T-20a-011, T-20a-094): the observed index candidate 4222017068256633289 (sources[].id of 'Aniyomi: Google Drive' in index.min.json, version 14.15) is NOT reproduced by name spellings 'Google Drive', 'GoogleDrive', 'Google drive', 'Google drive ', 'google drive', 'Googledrive' x 16 languages x versions 0 to 49. Resolve it with the real name, lang and version, or a real backup id, before T-20a-094 relies on the id rule. URL: none.
